event: Solenne stands on the last dry platform before the Floor 8 boss chamber's underground lake.
Tomás, forty meters up in the stalactites, reports the platforms and the dorsal gap.
He reports the boss forty meters down in the northeast quadrant, waiting.
Dayo wears Vesper's armored wrap; the party readies for the fight.
Solenne briefs the Tidebreaker's reactive armor: each damage type it takes, it resists.
She names the three-second reset window: they will cycle damage types.
Dayo will open with Iron Stance on the central platform; Solenne assigns the others.
Solenne says go.
Dayo Shield Rushes onto the central platform and plants in Iron Stance.
The Tidebreaker breaches twelve meters off, four meters tall, plated, with a dorsal gap.
Dayo tells it to come on, and it comes.
Its sweeping strike cracks the limestone, but Iron Stance holds Dayo in place.
Dayo's gauntlet strikes land, but the plates harden against impact by forty percent.
Nadia's knife lands Stumble; Dayo Shield Rushes the stumbling creature.
Tomás puts two Precision Shots into its lower seams; the armor angles for piercing.
Solenne's Arcane Bolt lands full value and Arcane Mark triggers on the boss.
The damage-type cycling works, and its HP drops cycle by cycle.
The armor stacks two resistances at once: it is adapting to their pattern.
Dayo's strike lands at half value; her HP drops from 427 to 361.
Phase 2 at sixty percent: Solenne warns it is building a profile; Dayo says it reads them.
Solenne looks to Nadia across the chamber.
Nadia says plainly that it needs chaos, and they have chaos.
Solenne sees it: random Chaos Grenade effects plus Arcane Mark leave nothing to learn.
Solenne lays a fresh Mark and says now; Nadia throws as Solenne pushes the Mark.
A golden notification: Harmony Skill Laughing Storm unlocked, Jester plus Arcanist.
The grenade lands Fear, Slow and Blind on the Tidebreaker at once.
Dayo's Shield Rush slides the debuffed boss three meters; its armor cannot adapt.
Tomás puts two arrows into the exposed dorsal gap.
Every hit rolls a second debuff; its HP falls to twenty-eight percent.
Phase 3: the armor locks neutral and the boss turns to unrestrained aggression.
Its lunging slam drops Dayo from 361 to 248 HP through Iron Stance.
Miriam calls Vesper; further hits drive Dayo down to 152 HP.
Miriam's Mending Touch heals, but the boss deals damage faster than she heals.
Dayo's HP falls to 91; she declares Unbroken Line.
Miriam and Dayo spend forty MP each; for thirty seconds Miriam's heals are instant.
The boss ramps up, and Dayo's HP is pushed down despite the instant heals.
At 107 HP, Defiant Last Stand fires: half damage, and she cannot fall below one.
The boss rears for a two-fisted slam; Vesper's Reinforcement lands on Dayo first.
The Reinforcement shatters absorbing the excess; Dayo stands at twelve HP.
Miriam pours in tripled heals and Dayo stabilizes at 190.
The Tidebreaker rears again; Tomás fires one arrow into the dorsal gap.
The boss collapses off the platform into the black water, dead.
Dayo sits down against a mineral deposit; Last Stand's end heal brings her to 275.
The System awards 1,500 shared XP, a Rare Boss Core and a Deepwater Bracer.
Miriam walks to Dayo, kneels and heals her shoulder.
Vesper lays the Core and the Deepwater Bracer beside Dayo: for you.
Dayo puts the bracer on her right wrist without saying thank you.
Nadia drops to the platform and calls it the scariest forty seconds of her life.
Dayo laughs her big laugh.
Solenne and Nadia confirm they both got the Laughing Storm notification.
Nadia takes full credit for the name; the System heard her energy.
Dayo levels up: Vanguard Level 11 to Level 12.
Tomás levels up: Pathfinder Level 12 to Level 13.
Tomás climbs down from the stalactites, having fired one arrow.
Dayo says good shot; Tomás says good hold.
The party rests in the Transition Hall above Floor 8.
Vesper studies the Core; Miriam records the Last Stand numbers.
Dayo scratches a new tally mark on her bracer: Floor 8.
Team Ironwall enters the Hall, thirty minutes after the boss fell.
Hex's left arm is field-dressed; Prita carries new binding material.
Solenne tells Brennan the Floor 8 boss is down.
Brennan takes in the uninjured party and the bracer: they cleared the Tidebreaker.
He asks if the Jester and Arcanist activation was what it looked like.
Solenne tells him it was a Harmony Skill.
Brennan says Apex has sought active Harmony teams for four months and found none.
He offers to arrange a conversation about resources and support.
Solenne says she will think about it.
Team Ironwall passes through the Hall and into the far corridor.
Nadia calls it a job offer or the start of a heist movie; nobody laughs.
Solenne faces the door to Floor 9, the rest floor; it opens.
